message.content: {"question":"Consider the following set of Matlab commands: x=linspace(-1,1,10); xx=linspace(-1,1); y=sin(pi*x); z=spline(x,y,xx); What is their result?","options":{"A":"They compute the coefficients of the not-a-knot cubic spline interpolating the function f(x) = sin(πx) in 10 equally spaced points in [-1, 1]","B":"They compute the coefficients of the natural cubic spline interpolating the function f(x) = sin(πx) in 10 equally spaced points in [-1, 1]","C":"They compute and evaluate, at 100 equally spaced points in [-1, 1], the constrained cubic spline interpolating the function f(x) = sin(πx) in 10 equally spaced points in [-1, 1]","D":"They compute and evaluate, at 100 equally spaced points in [-1, 1], the not-a-knot spline interpolating the function f(x) = sin(πx) in 10 equally spaced points in [-1, 1]"},"correct":"D"}
